name: claude-remote-peers
description: Message a Claude Code session on another machine with the same push delivery two sessions get on one machine: two ssh socket forwards, no files copied, no polling.

interface.shortDescription: Message a Claude Code session on another machine over ssh.
interface.longDescription: Fires when a Claude Code session must reach a Claude Code session on another host. The bridge script forwards each session's inbox socket to the other machine at the same path over ssh, prints the uds: address to pass to SendMessage, and stays up until stopped. Replies arrive as pushed cross-session messages, the same as from a session on the local machine. Nothing is copied between the machines and nothing polls.
defaultPrompt: Message the Claude Code session running on my other dev box.
Bridge this session to the Claude on host box-b so they can ping each other.
ListAgents does not show the session on the other machine; connect them.
